title: Operate a measurable awareness, education, and training program: concept decisions 1
teachingQuestion: Which intervention fits this audience and risk, and what behavior evidence proves it improved?
focalInsight: Match awareness, education, training, and champions to role decisions; measure behavior and refresh content.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Security Awareness
nodes.failureExample: Generic annual slides teach admin recovery.

nodes.label: Security Education
nodes.failureExample: Learner memorizes slogan but cannot handle novel case.

nodes.label: Security Training
nodes.decision: Use when role must do process/tool response.
nodes.failureExample: Responder watches video but never exercises evidence handling.

nodes.label: Role Based Training
nodes.failureExample: Developers and reception receive identical material.

nodes.label: Phishing Resistance
nodes.decision: Measure decision/report quality, not only clicks.
nodes.failureExample: User reports legitimate message as malicious.

nodes.label: Program Effectiveness
nodes.decision: Measure baseline, behavior, population, limitation, action.

nodes.label: Behavioral Metrics
nodes.definition: Observable actions linked to learning objective.

altSummary: Match awareness, education, training, and champions to role decisions; measure behavior and refresh content.
textFallback:
security awareness: Broad risk/expected-action communication. Decide: Use for recognition/reporting behavior. Example/failure: Generic annual slides teach admin recovery. Retrieve: Awareness builds recognition.
security education: Conceptual learning building judgment. Decide: Use for transferable principles. Example/failure: Learner memorizes slogan but cannot handle novel case. Retrieve: Education develops understanding.
security training: Practice for defined task performance. Decide: Use when role must do process/tool response. Example/failure: Responder watches video but never exercises evidence handling. Retrieve: Training needs capability evidence.
role based training: Learning tailored to role decisions/access/risk. Decide: Match task, consequence, environment, proficiency. Example/failure: Developers and reception receive identical material. Retrieve: Role specificity makes it useful.
phishing resistance: Recognize, safely verify, report deception. Decide: Measure decision/report quality, not only clicks. Example/failure: User reports legitimate message as malicious. Retrieve: Resistance includes safe verification.
security champions: Supported local advocates connecting security/delivery. Decide: Define role, time, escalation, authority. Example/failure: Champion named with no support. Retrieve: Champions extend, not replace ownership.
program effectiveness: Evidence intervention improved intended outcome. Decide: Measure baseline, behavior, population, limitation, action. Example/failure: 100% completion but errors persist. Retrieve: Effectiveness is outcome improvement.
behavioral metrics: Observable actions linked to learning objective. Decide: Set purpose, context, limit, owner, response. Example/failure: Click rate proves culture claim. Retrieve: Metrics need interpretation.
content review: Refresh content for changed threat/technology/roles. Decide: Set trigger, owner, evidence, approval. Example/failure: Obsolete MFA lesson ignores recovery fraud. Retrieve: Review keeps learning current.
